_comment: Every channel the Cindy controller handles in its remote-push dispatch, so this Host can prove it never pushes into the void. Extracted from apps/mobile/src/session/remoteSessionStore.ts (the `channel === '<x>'` comparisons inside applyRemotePush), plus the channels that dispatch by constant rather than by literal: SESSION_SYNC_CHANNEL, SESSION_ACTIVITY_CHANNEL, MAKER_EVENT_BATCH_CHANNEL (expanded before the switch), FILE_BROWSER_EVENT_CHANNEL and REMOTE_RESOURCE_CHANGED_CHANNEL. Push channels are not validated by the controller the way invokes are: an unknown channel is simply dropped, so nothing at runtime tells us we addressed a channel nobody reads.
